result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count no longer includes cancelled purchase orders. I ran the full offline test suite and it passed. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The change is in `PurchaseOrderStore.countPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/PurchaseOrderStore.java`. I added the existing `NOT_CANCELLED` condition to its count query, the same one the per-quarter and per-weekday reports use. I also added a sentence to the method's Javadoc saying cancelled orders aren't counted.

I left the shared `FOR_WAREHOUSE_REGION_IN_PERIOD` constant alone because another query uses it. Reps with no purchase orders in the period still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.
